premise: Little Fish wonders what lies beyond the rock pool; a wave carries him out into the huge sea, and kind Turtle swims beside him back home.
inspiration: The town-mouse-and-country-mouse fable (Aesop) told as a first adventure: the big world is wonderful, and home is still home.
lesson: It's good to explore, and good to come home.

en-US.title: Little Fish and the Big Sea
en-US.text: In the rock pool, beside the swaying fronds of {seaweed:enter} Seaweed, lived {fish:enter} {fish:go to pool} Little Fish, yellow with two blue stripes. {seaweed:live} Seaweed swayed, slow and gentle. {fish:face happy} The pool was cosy. But Little Fish kept wondering: [curious] what's out there? One day a wave came sloshing in over the rocks. {sfx:slosh solo} And when it went out again, {fish:go to sea} Little Fish went with it! {fish:face surprised} [in awe] The sea was ENORMOUS. Blue on every side, and no edges at all. {fish:shake} He felt very, very small. {fish:face sad} [short pause] Then a kind face came gliding up. {turtle:enter by swim} {turtle:go to fish by swim} It was Turtle. [warmly] Far from home, little one? I'll swim with you. {turtle:hearts} She swam beside him, slow and steady, until he could see the rocks. {fish:go to pool} Then home he swam. {seaweed:wobble} Seaweed waved her fronds. Welcome back! {fish:face happy} {fish:live} Little Fish wiggled his tail and fluttered his fins. [softly] The sea was wonderful. But the pool was home.

es-ES.title: El pececito y el mar grande
es-ES.text: En la charca, junto a las frondas de {seaweed:enter} Alga, vivía {fish:enter} {fish:go to pool} Pececito, amarillo con dos rayas azules. {seaweed:live} Alga se mecía, despacio y suave. {fish:face happy} La charca era acogedora. Pero Pececito no paraba de preguntarse: [curious] ¿qué habrá ahí fuera? Un día, una ola entró chapoteando por encima de las rocas. {sfx:slosh solo} Y cuando volvió a salir, {fish:go to sea} ¡Pececito se fue con ella! {fish:face surprised} [in awe] El mar era ENORME. Azul por todas partes, y sin bordes por ningún lado. {fish:shake} Se sintió muy, muy pequeño. {fish:face sad} [short pause] Entonces se acercó una cara amable, deslizándose. {turtle:enter by swim} {turtle:go to fish by swim} Era Tortuga. [warmly] ¿Tan lejos de casa, pequeño? Yo nado contigo. {turtle:hearts} Nadó a su lado, despacio y sin parar, hasta que se vieron las rocas. {fish:go to pool} Y entonces Pececito volvió nadando a casa. {seaweed:wobble} Alga movió sus frondas. ¡Bienvenido! {fish:face happy} {fish:live} Pececito meneó la cola y agitó las aletas. [softly] El mar era maravilloso. Pero la charca era su casa.
